purpose: Complete only the pre-existing CAP_NOT_REVIEWED candidate IDs from the exhaustive parent run; do not retrieve new candidates, alter thresholds, or select pairs by outcome.
allowed_inputs: original source image/GT files for metric recomputation only
candidate_rule: A row is eligible for second-pass review if and only if the parent row has review_status=CAP_NOT_REVIEWED and filter_reason=REVIEW_CAP. Every such row must be reviewed; zero backlog rows may remain.
image_high_similarity: RGB Pearson>=0.990 AND RGB MAE<=6.0 AND RGB PSNR>=24.0 AND grayscale SSIM>=0.95 under one D4 alignment
image_near_only: RGB Pearson>=0.950 AND RGB MAE<=12.0 AND grayscale SSIM>=0.80 under one D4 alignment
gt_near_similarity: foreground IoU>=0.95 AND pixel agreement>=0.995 under one D4 alignment; exact GT-D4 recorded separately
ssim: skimage.metrics.structural_similarity on 8-bit grayscale with data_range=255, win_size=7, gaussian_weights=False, use_sample_covariance=True, K1=0.01, K2=0.03
completion_gate: 33145 unique candidate pairs, all review_status=FULLY_REVIEWED, no CAP_NOT_REVIEWED rows, no new pair IDs, and independent metric verification
source_family_rules: unchanged; GT-only relations never merge image families; no transitive closure of unreviewed or low-confidence candidates
status_rule: Parent remains PARTIAL. Merged result is COMPLETE only if every completion-gate condition and independent verification pass; otherwise PARTIAL.
not_run: new metric evaluation on model predictions
